answer: Score agents by max-flow trust from a seed set of audited validators, with every endorsement edge capped. A sybil operator can spin up an ocean of keys named Saffron-1 through Opal-900, yet all their reputation must pass through the few edges honest agents actually granted them, so the whole farm shares one thin trickle. Pay rewards and grading seats by that flow, not by key count, and cloning stops paying.
